card.name: Middle of all-caps label words
card.fires_on: The middle piece of a word split across pieces, mostly in capitalized label text: NT in UNTIL, VERSE in ADVERSE (REACTIONS), IS in PHARYNGITIS.

modes.label: ADVERSE cross-reference
modes.description: VERSE inside ADVERSE, just before REACTIONS, in a see-section reference.

modes.label: Capitalized words in caps text
modes.description: A piece inside an all-caps word such as UNTIL or PHARYNGITIS.
modes.example: THE DRUG STOPPED U<<NT>>IL THE ETIOLOGY IS DETER

modes.label: Other web text
modes.description: A stray word like ISSUE in a web page header.
